offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures thin-film process equipment such as ion beam deposition, etch, MOCVD, laser annealing and wet processing systems. Sells to semiconductor, data storage, photonics and compound semiconductor manufacturers, and supports them with spare parts and service.

primary_products.value: ion beam deposition and etch systems; MOCVD systems; laser annealing systems; wet processing and single-wafer cleaning systems; spare parts

primary_services.value: equipment servicing and maintenance; upgrades and field support; process support

customer_segment.value: B2B: semiconductor fabs, advanced packaging makers, data storage, photonics and compound semiconductor manufacturers

end_markets.value: semiconductors; data storage; photonics; compound semiconductors; power electronics

revenue_model.value: product sales: process equipment systems sold to chip and device makers; service fees: spare parts, upgrades, service contracts and support

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds deposition, etch and annealing tools from purchased components, sold to chipmakers and device manufacturers

geography_served.value: global: Customers in the US, Asia-Pacific (China, Taiwan, Korea, Japan, Singapore) and Europe

specialization.value: related lines: ion beam, MOCVD, laser annealing and wet processing thin-film equipment

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct sales and service teams to fabs and device manufacturers; agents / brokers: regional sales representatives in some Asian markets

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: export controls on semiconductor equipment (US BIS), environmental and safety rules

notes: Merger with Axcelis was announced in 2025; description covers Veeco as standalone. Distribution details are approximate.
